GEN2 CALLABLE GOTCHA (corrected): a v2 onCall invoked with NO auth that reaches our code returns HTTP 401 ('unauthenticated' HttpsError) = GOOD/reachable; HTTP 403 = BAD (missing allUsers run.invoker, GFE rejects before our code). Verify a new callable: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -X POST <url> -d '{"data":{}}' → expect 401. Fix a 403 by re-adding allUsers run.invoker or delete+recreate.

TASK-013 SECRETS now live in Google Secret Manager (defineSecret, bound via the onCall secrets:[] option): SANITY_WRITE_TOKEN (Administrator scope) + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. ANTHROPIC_MODEL (=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) and ADMIN_EMAIL stay as defineString read from functions/.env. IMPORTANT: a key declared as defineSecret must NOT also be an active line in functions/.env or `firebase deploy` refuses — those two keys are commented out (#moved-to-secret-manager ...) in functions/.env, which keeps a local copy of the values. A defineString param must NOT be placed in the secrets:[] array (the CLI tried to resolve a secret literally named '{{ params.ANTHROPIC_MODEL }}' and 400'd).

Functions deps now include @anthropic-ai/sdk + @sanity/client + marked. Pure logic (slugify, markdownToPortableText) is in functions/lib/portableText.js with no firebase/SDK imports so vitest can import it (vitest.config include broadened to functions/**/*.test.ts).
